data.content_ref: inline:The method of segmenting digits by number-width abstracts the 792-digit problem to a general piecewise-linear formula D(n) = 9·1 + 90·2 + (n−99)·3 that any solution of this class inherits, reducing the specific computation to a single instance of the width-based allocation principle; it is refuted if the problem intended a different numeral system, because the digit-usage function would not be piecewise-linear in n and the abstraction to width-based segmentation would fail.
